name: tether
description: A tether terminal in the panel's profile menu: your shell, held in tether so Cophyla can type into what runs there. Also opens the terminal of a session Cophyla starts in this window's panel.

cophyla.home.description: The Cophyla home directory this window announces itself in, and learns Cophyla's tether from. Empty follows COPHYLA_HOME, then ~/.cophyla.

scripts.package: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/tether.vsix
